description: This is a FastAPI application implementing a REST API for managing notes, with endpoints for CRUD operations and health check, using in-memory storage.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Data model representing a note with id, title, content, creation, and update timestamps

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Data model for creating a note, including title and content fields

classes.name: NoteUpdate
classes.description: Data model for updating a note, with optional title and content fields

methods.name: datetime _now_utc()
methods.description: Returns the current UTC datetime with timezone info

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify the service is running

methods.name: create_note(payload: NoteCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new note with auto-incremented ID and timestamps

methods.name: list_notes()
methods.description: Lists all stored notes in insertion order

methods.name: get_note( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="The ID of the note to retrieve"), )
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, raises 404 if not found

methods.name: update_note( payload: NoteUpdate, note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="The ID of the note to update"), )
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID, supports partial updates of title and/or content

methods.name: delete_note( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="The ID of the note to delete"), )
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, raises 404 if note does not exist

ctags.name: delete_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="The ID of the note to delete"), )

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="The ID of the note to retrieve"), )

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.signature: ( payload: NoteUpdate, note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="The ID of the note to update"), )
